dct_description_sm: 2 copies DCP Covers Washington D.C. metropolitan area. Eastern corner of D.C. ca. 7 cm. within map area. Relief shown by hachures. Depths shown by soundings. Also shows rural householders' names and vegetation. Includes note and coat of arms below title. Library of Congress. Civil War maps (2nd ed.), 687 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. LC copy 1 halved and mounted on cloth backing. LC copy 2 brittle, missing large sections along margins, and mounted on cloth backing.
